title: 第七章 潜影
slug: 穿书被杀妻证道魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

莫非是要她做他的炉鼎？可她也并非水灵根，她轻轻拍了拍头，被自己尴尬到，想什么呢……

可原身记忆中，大伯谢临坤与三叔谢临浩确实纳了不少侍妾，其中不乏资质特殊的女修充作炉鼎。

修仙界的女修，要么拜入宗门正常修行，要么沦为散修艰难求生，其中不乏因资源匮乏，或是身负特殊灵根体质者，最终选择依附强者。

以慕宸的条件，若真有意，多得是女修趋之若鹜。

细想起来，倒是她自己从初见就……

今日种种窘态又浮现在眼前……谢清猗羞恼地伏在案上，将发烫的脸颊埋进臂弯里，窗外花香隐隐，夜风拂过廊下，吹得灵烛光影摇曳。

她郁闷地低低闷哼一声：“真是丢死人了，以后还是少见为妙。”

忽又想起白日里，家主夫人荣怀音手上有原身父母失踪后，唯一所留线索影留珠的事，谢清猗眉心轻蹙。

原身本就想寻自己父母，对方却拿这个想要拿捏原身，那里面到底里面藏着什么秘密。

想到此，她既然已打算明天回了天极仙府，今晚不去拿，那往后可能就更没机会了，不如趁此机会去寻一番？

原身记忆里，家主夫人与家主并不住同一院落。可那荣怀音修为也是金丹期，与原身不相上下，她绝不能正面相抗。她记得，原身储物戒里存了不少法宝法器，或许能有遮挡面容的。

谢清猗指尖一旋，冰蓝灵光自指间流转而出，瞬息之间，地面现出一口大木箱，裙裾摆动，她蹲在木箱旁，不停翻找起来。

“嗯……这斗篷，只能防御，不行。”

“帷帽？不行，不行，戴这个太麻烦……”

“这一块……”谢清猗将能用到的翻了一圈，才瞧见掌心里一块不算大的鲛纱模样的布料。她想起来了，这是从前师尊送原身鲛纱所制法衣时多出来的一块。

原身也不知道让师尊把其炼成遮面法宝。她轻轻一叹，垂眸看着掌中之物，如今这块虽不能彻底掩去面貌，但在同阶修士面前，对方也看不透鲛纱下的真容。

她随即又从储物戒里取出一件深紫色法袍，随手换上，面上系好鲛纱，抬指掐诀，周身气息收敛。

如此，谢家除家主等寥寥数人外，旁人察觉不到她的踪迹。

谢清猗放出神识轻探四周，按记忆中的路线朝荣怀音所住院落的方向望去，夜色沉沉，远处回廊间隐约有巡卫提灯而过，灵灯的幽光在晚风穿过的廊柱间明灭不定，她心中暗念，果然戒备森严。

看来，她须得万分小心了……这头一回做这种偷偷摸摸的事，心脏不由得倏然收紧，在胸腔里怦怦直跳。

屋内灵烛火光跳跃一瞬，那抹窈窕的身影已然消失。

Could it be that he wanted her to be his cauldron?But she was not Shuilinggen either. She patted her head lightly, feeling embarrassed by herself. What was she thinking...

But in the original memory, uncle Xie Linkun and third uncle Xie Linhao did take in many concubines, many of whom were female cultivators with special qualifications.

Female cultivators in the world of immortality either join a sect and practice normally, or they become casual cultivators and struggle to survive. Many of them choose to rely on strong men due to lack of resources or special spiritual constitutions.

Based on Mu Chen's conditions, if he is really interested, many female cultivators will flock to him.

Thinking about it carefully, she herself had...

All kinds of embarrassments came to mind today... Xie Qingyi lay on the desk in shame, burying his hot cheeks in his arms. There was a faint fragrance of flowers outside the window, and the night wind blew through the corridor, causing the light and shadow of the candle to sway.

She groaned depressedly: "It's really embarrassing. It's better to see it less often in the future."

Suddenly he remembered that during the day, Rong Huaiyin, the wife of the family, had the only clue left behind after her original parents disappeared, and Xie Qingyi frowned slightly.

The original person originally wanted to find his parents, but the other party used this to find out what secrets were hidden in the original person.

Thinking of this, since she has planned to go back to Tianji Immortal Mansion tomorrow, if she doesn't pick it up tonight, she may not have a chance in the future. Why not take this opportunity to look for it?

In the original memory, the wife of the house owner and the owner did not live in the same courtyard.But Rong Huaiyin's cultivation level was also at the Golden Core stage, which was on par with the original body. She could never confront him head-on.She remembered that her original storage ring contained many magic weapons, some of which might be able to cover her face.

Xie Qingyi twirled her fingertips, and ice-blue spiritual light flowed out from her fingers. In an instant, a large wooden box appeared on the ground, with the skirt of her skirt swinging. She squatted beside the wooden box and kept rummaging through it.

"Well...this cloak can only be used for defense, but it can't be used."

"A curtain hat? No, no, it's too troublesome to wear this..."

"This piece..." Xie Qingyi turned around what was available and saw a small piece of shark gauze-like fabric in the palm of his hand.She remembered that this was an extra piece of the robe made by the original Samesha as a gift from her master.

The original person didn't know that he asked his master to refine it into a face-shielding magic weapon.She sighed softly and lowered her eyes to look at the thing in her palm. Although this piece could not completely hide her face, in front of a monk of the same level, the other person could not see through the true appearance under the same gauze.

She then took out a dark purple robe from the storage ring, put it on casually, tied the shark gauze on her face, raised her fingers to perform the secret formula, and the aura around her body converged.

In this way, except for the head of the Xie family and a few other people, no one else could detect her traces.

Xie Qingyi used her spiritual consciousness to explore the surroundings and looked in the direction of Rong Huaiyin's courtyard according to the route in her memory. The night was dark, and there were vague patrols passing by with lanterns in the corridor in the distance.

It seemed that she had to be extremely careful... This was the first time she had done such a sneaky thing, and her heart couldn't help but tighten suddenly, pounding in her chest.

The light of the spiritual candle in the room jumped for a moment, and the graceful figure had disappeared.
